Desk Fountain Pen with Tapered Body
Vintage, Silver-Tone Nib Made in USA
This vintage Sheaffer desk fountain pen features a classic mid-century design with a sleek, tapered black resin body and a professional silver-tone nib. As a piece of American stationery history, Sheaffer's desk sets were staples of the executive office, known for their reliability and streamlined aesthetic that complemented the modernist decor of the mid-20th century.
Sleek tapered black resin body with silver-tone trim and nib
Nib stamped with readable "SHEAFFER" and "USA" identification marks
Includes heavy rounded desk base for vertical display and storage
Overall dimensions: 4" Length x 6" Width x 7" Height
Condition:
Fair to good vintage condition. The nib shows significant dried ink residue and purple staining, requiring cleaning. The barrel exhibits surface wear, light scratching, and some discoloration near the grip section. The desk base appears stable and intact with minor surface dust and typical age-related wear to the finish.
